instrument_en: Shirom–Melamed Burnout Measure — 2026 nine-item short form
scales: Physical fatigue (3 items); Cognitive weariness (3 items); Emotional exhaustion (3 items); authors support three-facet structure; no clinical diagnostic cutoffs cleared.
research_provenance: Michel JS, McGoey K, Shifrin NV, Shannon FA et al. Journal of Occupational Health Psychology 2026 31(5):415–428; first online 2026-07-23, DOI 10.1037/ocp0000442; development across NINE separate samples over FOUR phases, combining cross-sectional, panel and daily diary designs; aggregate participant N not reported in freely retrievable PubMed abstract (do not infer). Source originally SMBM-14; not SMBQ-22.
db_locales: Not registered in Holistic House 149 published DB definition keys (234 language versions); not in original PR #495 (386 keys) or prior 3926 research stable keys. Research metadata only.
en_form: Study published in English; exact participant-administered questionnaire and independent EN respondent-version verification not retrieved. Do not mark an independently validated EN translation.
ru_form: No independently validated RU respondent short-form questionnaire established.
es_form: No independently validated ES respondent short-form questionnaire established.
other_translations: Existing translations of longer SMBM/SMBQ cannot be considered independently validated SMBM-9; no new language edition substantiated.
target_population: Working adults / occupational burnout research, nine study samples in four phases (cross-sectional, panel and daily diary); total N/sample countries/respondent questionnaire languages need full-text check. Not clinically normed for Holistic House clients.
commercial_digital_rights: Commercial digital hosting, 9 exact item wordings, translation, online administration, scoring and interpretation NOT cleared with original SMBM rights owners and 2026 short-form authors; publisher abstract ©2026 APA all rights reserved. Third-party catalogue 'open with attribution' is NOT primary rights-holder clearance. Seek explicit written permission before product use.
validated_edition_evidence: PubMed PMID42490258 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42490258/ ; original 2026 DOI https://doi.org/10.1037/ocp0000442 ; prior SMBM meta-analysis https://doi.org/10.1037/ocp0000334 (distinct instrument length) ; APA permission policy https://blog.apapubs.org/2016/12/21/how-permissions-work-in-psyctests/
verification_notes: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. 3 items per facet; 2026 report supports three dimensions, high internal consistency and close convergence to SMBM14; no raw scale form, scoring coefficients, clinically applicable norms, cutoffs or languages verified. Cannot conflate with SMBQ22 and prior SMBM-6/11/16/19. Zero production/DB deployment.

instrument_en: Shirom–Melamed Burnout Measure — 2026 three-item ultra-brief composite
scales: One item each tapping physical fatigue, cognitive weariness, emotional exhaustion; a THREE-ITEM COMPOSITE rather than three psychometrically supported independently scored one-item subscales.
research_provenance: Michel JS, McGoey K, Shifrin NV, Shannon FA et al. Journal of Occupational Health Psychology 2026 31(5):415–428; first online 2026-07-23 DOI 10.1037/ocp0000442; same NINE samples and FOUR research phases as SMBM-9, NOT an additional independent new dataset; N not stated in accessible abstract; compared with parent SMBM14.
db_locales: Not registered in Holistic House 149 published definition keys; missing from original PR #495 and 3926-entry research master. Shares one source/study FAMILY with SMBM9; separate LENGTH/SCORING VERSION only.
en_form: Article published in English; administered EN form, respondent language and exact item text not independently verified. No new EN translation validation inferred.
ru_form: No independently validated RU 3-item respondent form verified.
es_form: No independently validated ES 3-item respondent form verified.
other_translations: Parent SMBM language lists cannot be transferred to 2026 three-item composite. Do not mark any language translated/validated without original fielded form and edition-specific psychometrics.
target_population: Employees / work-related burnout research across nine samples/four phases (same underlying evidence as SMBM9). No claim of stand-alone clinical, diagnostic or personnel-screening validity.
commercial_digital_rights: Commercial proprietary site reproduction and administration, exact three items, translations, composite scoring and cutoff use not licensed; APA copyright of 2026 paper and original scale permissions remain unresolved. Explicit rights-owner and short-form-authors written commercial SaaS clearance needed.
validated_edition_evidence: PubMed PMID42490258 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42490258/ ; journal DOI https://doi.org/10.1037/ocp0000442 ; APA permissions https://blog.apapubs.org/2016/12/21/how-permissions-work-in-psyctests/
verification_notes: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. Authors report LOWER reliability than SMBM9 but strong parent-form convergence; designed as minimal 3-item composite with one item per facet, NOT 3 validated subscales, no diagnostic cutoffs. Same development datasets as SMBM9; not independent language validation. Zero clinical automation, production use or merge.
